skins.name: Bibliosmia
skins.description: After being re-coordinated to reflect the national outfits of the people of Ursus , Istina wore this outfit to promote traditional cuisine at the food festival . Underneath the plain materials are countless intricate details, and only those who deem themselves wise come to seek answers.

skins.name: Honey Pilferer
skins.description: Beehunter's sleepwear. Fluffy, soft, comfortable, tight-fitting, and easy to wash, this outfit is suitable for both home use and as sleepwear. What nobody expected is that Beehunter would head straight to the food festival.

skins.name: Shaved-Ice Memories
skins.description: The work outfit worn by Magallan to make shaved ice during the food festival combines traditions of Higashi with characteristics of Rhine Labs . Breathable, well-insulated, and easy to move in, this outfit allows Magallan to fully devote herself to her work, even if in an igloo.
